item.title: visualstudio: What Would You Build in Azure If You Didn’t Have to Ask for a Budget First?
item.description:
The post says eligible Visual Studio subscribers may already have access to a personal Azure sandbox, making it easier to try .NET apps, serverless, containers, proofs of concept, or unfamiliar Azure services without requesting a budget first.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL Database Hyperscale Serverless auto-pause and auto-resume
item.description:
Azure SQL Database Hyperscale Serverless now supports auto-pause and auto-resume in public preview. Databases can pause during inactivity and resume automatically when activity returns.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: security: Threat matrix: Mapping threats across cloud web applications
item.description:
Microsoft introduced the Cloud Web Applications Threat Matrix, a MITRE ATT&CK-aligned framework for understanding and prioritizing threats against cloud-hosted web applications and serverless platforms. It is intended to help defenders map attacks and identify mitigations.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
